mechanism: exact-metric sequential activation mantissa code descent on the ideal output-achievable target
build: append-only: parent bytes + fixed separator + implementation module
hooks: hif4_calibration_and_quantize_weight (post-processor: store H = (W_hat-W)^T W_hat and the parent ridge c)
hif4_dynamic_quantize_activation (post-processor: rebuild G and run one exact sequential descent pass)
untouched: parent weight encoder and every shared HiF4 helper (byte-identical)

fixed_choices.target: ideal J(X) = ||(X - T) W_hat^T||^2 with T = X_ref C G^{-1}; L - J is independent of X
fixed_choices.metric: G = h_inv^{-1} - c I rebuilt from the parent state, no rank truncation, no low-rank sketch
fixed_choices.ridge: c = mean(diag(h_inv^{-1} - W_hat^T W_hat)), stored as a scalar at calibration
fixed_choices.cross_matrix: H = (W_hat - W)^T W_hat stored fp32 per layer, W = nvfp4 decode of the weight pair (the evaluator's ref_weight frame; a parent-frame reconstruction is rejected by the L-J invariance test)
fixed_choices.candidate_set: one element of one natural 4-element group, mantissa code +-1 at fixed scale_factor/lv2/lv3
fixed_choices.block_order: ascending natural 64-channel blocks, groups 0..15 in order
fixed_choices.gradient_refresh: exact after every accepted move: g += delta G[sl, :]
fixed_choices.accept_rule: exact quadratic 2 <delta, g_cur> + delta^T G_gg delta < 0

verify.controls: A append-only+isolated import, B parent-off bit identity+wide bypass, C H/ridge/G recovery, D monotonicity+predicted-cost+gradient finite difference, E determinism+state round-trip
verify.real_case: layer0/q window1 rows128: dL=-21.8002% (probe ideal/seq -21.8002%), predicted vs true gap 8.8e-7, gradient rel 1.1e-5, H_gap 0, G_rel 1.2e-6

outcome.decision: closed for submission at full coverage; no version number assigned
outcome.plan_section_3_3: falsified: estimated +2-2.5s from a CPU proxy; measured ~40x higher

micro_optimisation_ceiling.conclusion: the cost is dispatch-bound, not sync-bound; a per-group Python loop cannot fit the gate at any micro-optimisation level, so the mechanism can only survive with fewer sequential iterations

schedule_frontier.note: true output squared error on real 4B data; all four schedules share every pre-registered fixed choice and differ only in sequential-iteration structure
schedule_frontier.jacobi: accepted_rows=0 at every pass count: a whole-layer simultaneous proposal is always jointly rejected, so the mechanism's value is the sequential refresh, not the proposal
schedule_frontier.conclusion: groupstep recovers 88% (in=2560) / 64% (in=4096) of seq p1 with 1/40 the sequential iterations
